editorHelpMap:
Scroll to zoom the page view (print scale is unchanged).
On touch screens, use two fingers to pan/zoom; fullscreen also allows one-finger panning.
Drag objects and their handles with one finger.
Align map uses one finger and moves terrain and course together.
Click a tool, then click the page to place.
Graphics: drag to resize; Ctrl/Cmd = keep proportions; Shift = crop.
Escape cancels a tool. Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes.
editorHelpTemplate:
Edit shared objects that appear on every map using this template.
Pick a preview course to see the real control description height.
Scroll to zoom the page view; print scale is set in Page.
On touch screens, use two fingers to pan/zoom; fullscreen also allows one-finger panning. Align map and object dragging use one finger.
Click a tool, then click the page to place.
Graphics: drag to resize; Ctrl/Cmd = keep proportions; Shift = crop.
Changes autosave. Escape cancels a tool.
curveHint: Alt-drag a vertex to add curve handles.
